title: VerifierProofResult.v1
description: The result of the PROOF GATE that stands between a drafted ExtractorSnippet / GeneratedWorkerSpec and any use. It REQUIRES sandbox_passed (the snippet ran in an isolated sandbox — temp dir, no secrets, no network unless allowed — and its unit test passed) AND proof_passed (the named proof_scripts all passed). gate_decision is derived: it may be 'approved' ONLY when both are true (and, for high-risk, human sign-off is present); otherwise 'rejected'/'needs_human_approval'. Generated code never executes as a production worker without an approved result here. Deterministic when evaluated_at is injected.

result_id.description: content-addressed over (subject_id, proof_script_ids, sandbox_passed, proof_passed); version in metadata, never in the id

subject_id.description: the ExtractorSnippet or GeneratedWorkerSpec id this gate evaluated

sandbox_passed.description: REQUIRED — the snippet ran in an isolated sandbox and its unit test passed; false means the gate cannot approve

proof_passed.description: REQUIRED — every named proof_script passed; false means the gate cannot approve

gate_decision.description: derived — 'approved' ONLY when sandbox_passed AND proof_passed (and human sign-off for high-risk); else rejected/needs_human_approval

proof_script_ids.description: the proofs that were run (lineage to the GeneratedWorkerSpec.proof_scripts)

network_used.description: true only if the recipe explicitly allowed it; unexpected network fails the gate

secrets_present.description: pinned false — a sandbox run never carries secrets

human_signoff_id.description: the accountable human approval, required when subject is high_risk (gate_decision=needs_human_approval until present)
